canonical_project: Nebius Highridge Pennsylvania AI Data Center Campus

location.site: Highridge Business Park, at or near Interstate 81 and Gordon Mountain Road

capacity_phasing.description: Initial phase expected/targeted to be operational by October 2027.
Nebius anticipates phased power delivery reaching 660 MW by January 2029.
Nebius anticipates 1,000+ MW of phased power delivery by November 2029.

development_facts.buildings: Nebius August 6, 2026 open-house deck shows a 4-building design; DCD July 27, 2026 report says site plans suggest six single-story buildings.
development_facts.power: Nebius says it has secured a dedicated Energy Service Agreement with PPL Electric Utilities for new energy infrastructure built specifically for the campus.
development_facts.grid_side_evidence: PJM PPL-2025-0008 is an unnamed Gordon, PA / Frackville-area 230 kV customer-service request with 290 MW initial 2027 load, 300 MW projected 2028 load, and 600 MW projected 2029 load; timing and geography are strongly consistent with the Highridge campus but PJM does not name Nebius.
development_facts.cooling: Air-cooled and closed-loop liquid-cooling systems are planned to minimize water needs.
development_facts.backup_power: Nebius says the design includes BESS capable of about 30 minutes of backup/redundant power.
development_facts.jobs: Nebius open-house materials list approximately 1,000 construction jobs over a roughly three-year build and about 100-150 full-time positions.

history.reason: Nebius project page and August 6, 2026 open-house materials show an active first phase of development and local community process, but not final construction/energization.
Nebius identifies the project as in Butler Township, Schuylkill County, within Highridge Business Park.
Nebius open-house/community materials were updated through August 10, 2026 cache-busted PDF URLs; open-house deck itself is dated August 6, 2026.

why_not_in_baseline: Not present in the 208 baseline canonical_project list; distinct from baseline Nebius Independence, MO and Vineland, NJ records, with details published after the baseline freeze.
contradictions: Building count conflict: Nebius August 6, 2026 open-house deck says 4-building design, while DCD July 27, 2026 says site plans suggest six single-story buildings.

Grid-side evidence limit: PJM PPL-2025-0008 independently documents a 600 MW Gordon/Frackville-area customer-service request through 2029, but does not name Nebius and does not independently confirm the full 1.2 GW buildout.
